decisions.source_name: Muhlenbergia involuta Swallen (IPNI display without multiplication sign)
decisions.action: IPNI records the name as Muhlenbergia involuta Swallen, Amer. J. Bot. 19:436 fig.2 (1932); POWO marks the accepted taxon × involuta. Do not create a second learner taxon based only on omission of ×.
Keep Lindheimer's muhly as an independently accepted species, not a synonym of the hybrid.
Keep seep muhly as an independently accepted species, not a synonym of the hybrid.
Under POWO this historical name maps to Lindheimer's muhly, NOT to Muhlenbergia × involuta.
Under POWO this historical name maps to seep muhly, NOT to Muhlenbergia × involuta.
Record the POWO/WCVP accepted parental formula as a taxon-level statement, not evidence of parentage for an unvouchered learner image or new field specimen.

decisions.source_name: Existing public learner hybrid photographs and historical plate
decisions.action: Retain existing provisional photo/voucher identity hold. Source-labelled UT Austin Bob Harms reference photos and historical illustration do not independently demonstrate that a particular observed clump has both named parents; no photographic reidentification or rights decision in this lane.

decisions.source_name: Unnamed intermediate Muhlenbergia plant in Central Texas
decisions.action: Do not assign × involuta solely from intermediate habit, co-occurrence, or photo captions. Retain parent/hybrid ambiguity pending a tied voucher with comparative reproductive morphology and, where needed, expert/genetic confirmation.
The inspected POWO hybrid entry does not display an additional synonym list; do not infer that either parent's synonyms are synonyms of the hybrid or invent a historical alias.
